paddle_a.speed(0)
paddle_a.shape("square")
paddle_a.color("white")
paddle_a.shapesize(stretch_wid=6, stretch_len=1)
paddle_a.penup()
paddle_a.goto(-350, 0)

paddle_b.speed(0)
paddle_b.shape("square")
paddle_b.color("white")
paddle_b.shapesize(stretch_wid=6, stretch_len=1)
paddle_b.penup()
paddle_b.goto(350, 0)

ball.speed(40)
ball.shape("square")
ball.color("white")
ball.penup()
ball.goto(0, 0)

ball.dy = -0.2

score_b = 0
